synopsis: The glossary identifies EN 50129 within a group of European railway standards covering reliability and safety management, software and electronic signaling [f15359]. Chapter 10 states that EN 50129 was not verified in this research, and the glossary repeats that limitation [f7716, f15361]. More specifically, the research did not verify risk scaling, validation against physical data, validity envelopes and transfer rules, or remaining physical evidence for a group that includes EN 50129 [f8155]. Its relevance to off-road automatic braking also remains unverified, so the booklet provides a definition but no verified basis for applying it to this use case [f15359, f8155].

relations.note: The glossary repeats Chapter 10's unverified-status statement for the same four standards.
Specifies unverified validation topics and relevance to off-road automatic braking.
Adds specific verification gaps to the glossary's general unverified-status statement.
